text:
Predicates:
Roses(x) ::: x are roses.
GivenOut(x, y) ::: x are given out on TV at time y.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: the show Breaking Bad.
Premises:
∀x (GivenOut(x, monday_at_8pm) → Roses(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOut(x, monday_at_8pm) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
If Roses(x) ∧ GivenOut(x, monday_at_8pm), then OnMondayAt8pm(x) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
